Details

This paragraph is justified, set in a fourth family and with almost no leading, and it runs the full width of the container so that a reader's eye has a long way to travel back to the start of the next line, which is exactly the kind of block that people skip. It keeps going for a while longer so that the measure can be taken reliably by the review tool that reads this fixture during the automated tests.
